fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner present. Reproduced the flake on this branch: go test -trimpath -count=20 -run TestWebRootHandlerServesEveryProject ./internal/api/ failed 2 of 20 with 'TempDir RemoveAll cleanup: unlinkat .../001: directory not empty'. Root cause: GET / and /p/<name>/runs reach WebDaemonSource, whose healthCache.get (internal/api/web_daemon.go) starts a background runHealth goroutine; it is still running and briefly creating files under the projects when the test returns and t.TempDir's RemoveAll runs. Files listed in a cleanup before RemoveAll and again 2 s later match, so the writer makes short-lived files only. The planner asked where the fix should live (product-side awaitable refresh or test only); the arbiter decided health-refresh-drained-in-tests: track each background refresh inside internal/api (unexported WaitGroup or counter) and have the page-serving web tests wait for in-flight refreshes in a t.Cleanup registered after their t.TempDir calls; production behaviour, exported API and WebRootHandler's signature unchanged; no sleeps, no retries, no synchronous refresh. Side note: the same run also tripped the enclosing-root guard on .rhiza-root/usage.live.json, which a live agent's status line on the machine writes; it is unrelated to this test.
fields.title: Plan of the flaky TestWebRootHandlerServesEveryProject fix (autonomous)
